examples.zh: 听完这个消息，他默默无语。
examples.en: Hearing the news, he said nothing.

examples.zh: 两人默默无语地坐了一下午。
examples.en: The two sat in silence all afternoon.

examples.zh: 面对批评，她只是默默无语。
examples.en: Faced with criticism she simply stayed silent.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; quiet, often sad.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，气氛安静，常带伤感。

meaning.en: Pure white and without a blemish.
meaning.zh: 纯白干净，没有一点瑕疵。

examples.zh: 新娘穿着洁白无瑕的婚纱。
examples.en: The bride wore a spotless white wedding dress.

examples.zh: 雪后的大地洁白无瑕。
examples.en: After the snow the land was pure and unblemished.

examples.zh: 她有一颗洁白无瑕的心。
examples.en: She has a pure and flawless heart.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; literal and figurative (purity).
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语，可指颜色，也喻品德纯洁。

natural: give all one has to help

meaning.en: To give all one has to help someone.
meaning.zh: 拿出所有的钱财帮助别人。

examples.zh: 朋友遇到困难，他倾囊相助。
examples.en: When his friend was in trouble, he gave everything he had.

examples.zh: 多亏邻居倾囊相助，我们才渡过难关。
examples.en: Thanks to our neighbour's generosity, we got through the crisis.

examples.zh: 老人把全部积蓄都拿出来，倾囊相助灾区。
examples.en: The old man gave his entire savings to the disaster area.

usage.en: Predicate; implies giving everything one has.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，含拿出全部财物之意。

meaning.en: Having talent that stands out from others.

examples.zh: 这位年轻作曲家才华出众。
examples.en: The young composer is outstandingly talented.

examples.zh: 她才华出众，毕业后很快被名企录用。
examples.en: Outstandingly gifted, she was soon hired by a top firm after graduating.

examples.zh: 他是一位才华出众的设计师。
examples.en: He is a brilliantly talented designer.

meaning.en: To be constantly on the move and worn out with work.
meaning.zh: 为生活或工作四处奔走，辛苦劳累。

examples.zh: 为了养家，他整年奔波劳碌。
examples.en: To feed his family he is on the road and working hard all year.

examples.zh: 奔波劳碌了一天，大家都累坏了。
examples.en: After a day of running around, everyone was exhausted.

examples.zh: 父母一辈子奔波劳碌，才供我读完大学。
examples.en: My parents toiled all their lives to put me through university.

usage.en: Predicate; often about making a living.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常指为生计奔忙。

meaning.en: A wish for wealth, status and good luck.
meaning.zh: 祝愿财富、地位和吉利都有。

examples.zh: 祝您新春快乐，富贵吉祥！
examples.en: Happy New Year; may you have wealth and good fortune!

examples.zh: 红包上写着“富贵吉祥”四个字。
examples.en: The red packet bore the four characters for wealth and good fortune.

examples.zh: 愿你一家富贵吉祥，平安喜乐。
examples.en: May your family enjoy prosperity, luck, peace and joy.

usage.en: Greeting; seen on couplets and cards.
usage.zh: 祝福语，常见于对联、贺卡。

examples.zh: 广袤无垠的草原一直延伸到天边。
examples.en: The boundless grassland stretches to the horizon.

examples.zh: 站在山顶，眼前是广袤无垠的大地。
examples.en: On the summit, a vast land spreads before you.

examples.zh: 广袤无垠的宇宙至今充满未知。
examples.en: The limitless universe is still full of unknowns.

usage.en: Mainly attributive; for land, sky and space.
usage.zh: 多作定语，形容土地、天空、宇宙。

meaning.en: Weak in will and unable to get things done.
meaning.zh: 意志软弱，没有办事能力。

examples.zh: 他被批评为软弱无能的领导。
examples.en: He was criticised as a weak, ineffectual leader.

examples.zh: 面对欺负，他软弱无能，只会忍让。
examples.en: Faced with bullying, he was spineless and merely gave way.

examples.zh: 软弱无能的政府难以赢得民心。
examples.en: A weak and incompetent government can hardly win people's hearts.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，批评意味强。

meaning.en: Everyone feels the same way about this.
meaning.zh: 大家的心情、想法都一样。

examples.zh: 盼望和平，人同此心，心同此理。
examples.en: Everyone longs for peace; we all share the same heart and reason.

examples.zh: 人同此心，谁都希望孩子平安成长。
examples.en: We all feel alike: everyone wants children to grow up safe.

examples.zh: 想家是人同此心的事。
examples.en: Missing home is something everybody feels.

usage.en: Often paired as 人同此心，心同此理.

meaning.en: A moment; usually in negatives, 'not even for a moment'.
meaning.zh: 一会儿，片刻；多用于否定，如“一时一刻也不”。

examples.zh: 我一时一刻也不能离开孩子。
examples.en: I can't leave the child for a single moment.

examples.zh: 这件事不是一时一刻能解决的。
examples.en: This can't be solved in a moment.

examples.zh: 他一时一刻都没有忘记承诺。
examples.en: Not for one moment did he forget his promise.

usage.en: Mostly with 不/没/也, as an adverbial.
usage.zh: 多与“不”“没”“也”连用，作状语。

natural: shrink back at the crucial moment

meaning.en: To lose nerve and back out at the decisive moment.
meaning.zh: 到了关键时刻畏惧后退。

equivalents: back out at the crucial moment

examples.zh: 决赛当天，他竟然临阵退缩了。
examples.en: On the day of the final he lost his nerve.

examples.zh: 既然答应了，就不能临阵退缩。
examples.en: Having agreed, you can't back out now.

examples.zh: 她从不在困难面前临阵退缩。
examples.en: She never shrinks back in the face of difficulty.

usage.en: Predicate; slightly different from 临阵脱逃, which means deserting.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；与“临阵脱逃”相比，侧重畏缩后退。

meaning.en: To cut off all dealings with someone.

examples.zh: 两家因为遗产纠纷断绝往来。
examples.en: The two families cut off contact over an inheritance dispute.

examples.zh: 他和老朋友断绝往来已有十年。
examples.en: He has had no contact with his old friend for ten years.

examples.zh: 两国一度断绝往来。
examples.en: The two countries once severed all relations.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，可指人、家族、国家。

examples.zh: 春天来了，野草蓬蓬勃勃地长出来。
examples.en: Spring has come and wild grass is shooting up.

examples.zh: 新兴产业发展得蓬蓬勃勃。
examples.en: Emerging industries are booming.

examples.zh: 孩子们蓬蓬勃勃的朝气感染了大家。
examples.en: The children's vigour infected everyone.

usage.en: Predicate, adverbial or attributive; usually with 地/的.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语、定语，常带“地”“的”。

meaning.en: To be successful in one's career; also a wish.
meaning.zh: 事业取得成功；也用作祝愿。

examples.zh: 祝你学业进步，事业有成！
examples.en: Wishing you success in your studies and career!

examples.zh: 他年纪轻轻就事业有成。
examples.en: He was successful in his career at a young age.

examples.zh: 事业有成之后，他回馈家乡。
examples.en: Once successful in business, he gave back to his hometown.

usage.zh: 可用于描述，也可用于祝福。

meaning.en: Leftover food; also figuratively crumbs of charity.
meaning.zh: 吃剩下的饭菜，也比喻别人施舍的一点点东西。

examples.zh: 他靠捡拾别人的残羹剩饭度日。
examples.en: He survived on other people's leftovers.

examples.zh: 别把残羹剩饭都倒掉，可以喂小动物。
examples.en: Don't throw all the scraps away; they can feed small animals.

examples.zh: 我不稀罕你施舍的残羹剩饭。
examples.en: I don't want the scraps you toss me.

usage.en: Object; also 残羹冷炙, which is more literary.
usage.zh: 多作宾语；也作“残羹冷炙”，更书面。

natural: fortune, status, long life and joy

meaning.en: The four blessings: fortune, rank and salary, long life, and joy.
meaning.zh: 福气、官禄、长寿、喜庆，四种吉祥。

examples.zh: 春联上写着“福禄寿喜”。
examples.en: The spring couplet reads 'Fortune, Rank, Longevity, Joy'.

examples.zh: 这幅画寓意福禄寿喜，送给老人最合适。
examples.en: The painting stands for the four blessings, ideal for an elder.

examples.zh: 祝您福禄寿喜，样样齐全。
examples.en: May you have fortune, rank, long life and joy, the full set.

usage.en: Auspicious motif; seen on couplets, ornaments and greetings.
usage.zh: 吉祥语，常见于春联、饰物和祝福语。
